name: Libre: VR Video Browser
summary:
Libre is a web browser made for watching video in VR.

Browse any site like a normal browser. When you find a video, press its Fullscreen button (or Libre's ▶ VR button) and it opens in Libre's immersive player, picking up where you left off.

THE VR PLAYER
• 180° and 360° videos, flat or 3D (side-by-side and top-bottom)
• Zoom with the thumbstick and move the picture up or down with A/B
• Adjust 3D depth, width and height for a comfortable picture
• Passthrough mode with an adjustable mask to see your room
